member.name: T:Suss.TikTok.Client.Auth.ITikTokAuthProvider
member.summary:
Abstracts the acquisition of a TikTok Marketing API access token.
This is the primary extensibility point for authentication. The library ships with two built-in implementations:
– returns a pre-issued long-lived token from configuration.
– exchanges an OAuth authorization code for an access token.
Implement this interface to support additional strategies (e.g., refreshing tokens from a secrets vault, or rotating tokens fetched from a custom token service).
Unlike SDK-based clients, TikTok auth resolves to a simple bearer string that is attached to every request via the Access-Token header. The token is cached by callers, so this method may perform a network call (token exchange) on first use.

member.name: T:Suss.TikTok.Client.Auth.OAuthAuthCodeAuthProvider
member.summary:
Authentication provider that performs the TikTok OAuth 2.0 authorization-code exchange to mint an access token.
Workflow:
A user authorizes the app in TikTok's consent screen.
TikTok redirects back with a one-time auth_code.
This provider POSTs app_id + secret + auth_code to /open_api/v1.3/oauth2/access_token/ and receives a long-lived access_token.
The resolved token is cached for the lifetime of this provider (registered as a singleton) so the exchange happens at most once. The exchange is guarded by a to be safe under concurrent first use.
member.param: An used to call the token endpoint.
Client options carrying the app id, secret, and auth code.

member.name: T:Suss.TikTok.Client.Configuration.AuthMode
member.summary:
Specifies the authentication strategy used to obtain a TikTok Marketing API access token. Configured via .
Unlike Google's DV360 (which uses service-account or interactive OAuth credentials handled by an SDK), TikTok's Marketing API is a raw REST API secured by a long-lived access_token passed in the Access-Token request header. This enum lets the client either reuse a pre-issued token or perform the OAuth 2.0 authorization-code exchange to mint one.

member.name: T:Suss.TikTok.Client.Exceptions.TikTokApiException
member.summary:
Represents an error returned by the TikTok Marketing API.
The TikTok Marketing API is "envelope based": every response returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body shaped as { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "...", "data": { ... } }. A non-zero indicates a business/validation failure even though the HTTP status is success. All services in this library translate non-zero envelopes (and transport failures) into a so consumers never have to parse raw envelopes.

member.summary:
Low-level transport abstraction over the TikTok Marketing API.
Hides the repetitive concerns of every API call behind a small surface:
Composing the full URL from base host + version + relative path.
Attaching the Access-Token header from the configured auth provider.
Serializing/deserializing JSON and unwrapping the standard envelope.
Translating non-zero envelope codes and transport faults into .
All resource services depend on this abstraction rather than on directly, which keeps mapping logic in services and transport logic in one place.
